notes: Level 2 starts directly on real metric cards; its highlighted opening lines and three/six-entry notebook requirements are exercised by the offline suite.
Real-time mutation timestamps verify that three- and six-metric next actions appear with Alex’s final text, and that the inter-speaker interval is shorter.
Student behaviour typography is larger than the supporting risk label.
The shared Conversation gained optional pace and last-message callbacks. All 11 existing Level 1 feedback, reading-time and audio checks passed with default behaviour retained.
The 52-check Level 2 suite and Level 1 feedback checks use real intervals. Partner integration and exact-package release checks use the browser clock.
Offline checks use exact HTML bytes through an in-memory HTTPS origin because managed Chromium blocks file://. Opening a local file in a particular user browser was not directly observed.
Narrative ownership is mapped in LEVEL2_NARRATIVE_AUDIT.md. Finished partner cinematics and Level 3 priorities remain outside this build.
The first partner integration attempt found the prior development server had stopped. Restarting the repository’s Vite command resolved the connection refusal; the full integration suite then passed.
